items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: I was studying with one of the principal flutists in the New Orleans Symphony Orchestra, Richard Harrison

ctx.x: Interesting, yeah. And so you went through the whole classical repertoire?

Right. I went through all of that. Studied at NOCCA with Ellis but actually that was interesting because at NOCCA even though I played with Ellis I was studying classical music and I was studying with one of the principal flutists in the New Orleans Symphony Orchestra, Richard Harrison. And Richard was a product of Juilliard and Europe and studying independently in Europe with different people. And you know he got me ready to go to Eastman.
